claims: Kenneth Blakeney is the head men's basketball coach at Howard University.
Kenneth Blakeney has held the position of head men's basketball coach at Howard University since 2019.
Kenneth Blakeney led the Bison to consecutive MEAC Tournament titles in 2023 and 2024.
Kenneth Blakeney led the Bison to back-to-back NCAA Tournament appearances.
Kenneth Blakeney led the Bison to the program's first-ever March Madness win.
Kenneth Blakeney was the 2022-23 MEAC Coach of the Year.
Kenneth Blakeney was the BOXTOROW HBCU Coach of the Year.
Kenneth Blakeney led Howard to three consecutive MEAC winning seasons (2021-24).
Before joining Howard University, Kenneth Blakeney held coaching roles at James Madison, Delaware, Seton Hall, and Harvard.
